# Harvard University

> > Harvard University is a world-leading institution offering undergraduate, graduate, and professional education across 12 schools with excellence in teaching, learning, and research.

Harvard University operates as a federated institution with multiple schools and divisions serving diverse learner populations from undergraduates to lifelong learners. The university provides comprehensive academic programs, research opportunities, and professional development across disciplines ranging from arts and sciences to engineering, law, medicine, business, and divinity.

## Key Topics

- Graduate Programs
- Undergraduate Education
- Professional Development
- Continuing Education
- Online Learning

## Core University

- [Harvard University](https://www.harvard.edu): Harvard University homepage featuring excellence in teaching, learning, and research.
- [Index of departments, schools, and affiliates](https://www.harvard.edu/a-to-z): Alphabetical directory of Harvard's schools, departments, centers, and affiliates.
- [Schools](https://www.harvard.edu/schools): Directory of Harvard's undergraduate college, 12 graduate schools, and institutes.
- [Academics](https://www.harvard.edu/academics): Overview of Harvard's academic programs across all learner types and life phases.

## Undergraduate & College

- [Harvard College](https://college.harvard.edu): Harvard College homepage with admissions, student life, and campus culture.

## Graduate Schools

- [Harvard Kenneth C. Griffin Graduate School of Arts and Sciences](https://gsas.harvard.edu): Graduate School of Arts and Sciences with PhD programs and student resources.
- [Faculty of Arts & Sciences](https://www.fas.harvard.edu): Faculty of Arts & Sciences homepage with academic programs and research initiatives.
- [Harvard Law School](https://hls.harvard.edu): Harvard Law School homepage with admissions, academics, and student resources.
- [Harvard Graduate School of Education](https://www.gse.harvard.edu): Graduate School of Education preparing education leaders and innovators globally.
- [Harvard Graduate School of Design](https://www.gsd.harvard.edu): Graduate School of Design educating leaders in architecture and urban design.
- [Harvard John A. Paulson School of Engineering and Applied Sciences](https://www.seas.harvard.edu): SEAS news featuring research, faculty innovation, and engineering applications.
- [Harvard Divinity School](https://hds.harvard.edu): Harvard Divinity School for rigorous religious studies in a nonsectarian setting.

## Professional & Continuing Education

- [Professional and Lifelong Learning](https://www.harvard.edu/academics/professional-and-lifelong-learning): Harvard's professional development, executive, and online learning programs.
- [Harvard Division of Continuing Education](https://www.dce.harvard.edu): Division of Continuing Education offering extension, summer, and professional programs.

## Research & Institutes

- [Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study](https://www.radcliffe.harvard.edu): Radcliffe Institute for interdisciplinary advanced study and research.

## Optional

- [Federal Lawsuits](https://www.harvard.edu/federal-lawsuits): Information on federal lawsuits involving Harvard University.
